context.body: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

observations.body: Armed divisions from every tribe come to Hebron with undivided purpose, and Israel supplies food for three days of joy.
observations.label: All tribes gather to make David king: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, tribal divisions, commanders, and all Israel, Hebron and the gathering routes, numbering, coming with full heart, preparing for war, supplying food, eating, drinking, and rejoicing visible within David's story or later memory.
observations.label: All tribes gather to make David king: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 12:23–40 as its own succession, retelling, and temple preparation David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places the accession becomes a whole-Israel assembly with material abundance inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
